existing_runtime_capability_policy.missingOrUnknown: Does not satisfy a required information item. Required items differ by requested capability.
existing_runtime_capability_policy.storage: Existing GuestProfiles + ReadinessProfiles; gates recomputed, not trusted from client completeness/steps.

guide.fields.intent.goal.decision_affected: Which requested task to serve and which capability's facts may be needed; no coverage-path recommendation follows from goal alone.
guide.fields.intent.goal.requirement: Conditional: required to scope a personal comparison/task when no clear confirmed request is already known. General education/browsing can remain available.
guide.fields.intent.goal.trigger: New or changed task whose goal is unresolved; otherwise reuse the confirmed request.
guide.fields.intent.goal.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit inline selection or clear confirmed user report, including an explicit task-entry action with known meaning. Any interpretation changing meaning needs confirmation; retain provenance/revision.
guide.fields.intent.goal.unknown_conflict_handling: Keep unanswered/unknown/deferred explicit. Something else is unresolved until enough meaning is known. If goals coexist, clarify which to do first only when necessary; do not assume inconsistency. Conflicting task interpretations require clarification without overwriting prior reports.
guide.fields.intent.goal.source_data_layer: Customer-reported intent in the existing guide envelope; question-map T01. No L01–L04 evidence needed to establish intent.
guide.fields.intent.goal.readiness_gate: Requested-task/input-scope gate only. Does not establish eligibility, personal fit, source acceptance or recommendation release.

guide.fields.intent.goalDetail.decision_affected: Clarifies an ambiguous or uncategorized request and its task boundaries.
guide.fields.intent.goalDetail.requirement: Optional for a clear goal; conditional only when a requested specific task otherwise cannot be understood.
guide.fields.intent.goalDetail.trigger: Something else or ambiguous free text, only to the extent missing meaning matters. Do not require text after a sufficient inline selection.
guide.fields.intent.goalDetail.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit relevant user text plus confirmation of a material interpretation; a previously confirmed specific request may supply this detail. Do not collect unnecessary sensitive details.
guide.fields.intent.goalDetail.unknown_conflict_handling: Missing text remains missing and does not imply a goal. Preserve unresolved/deferred status and ask only for the missing meaning when needed. If it contradicts the selected goal, clarify the current task before dependent personal work.
guide.fields.intent.goalDetail.source_data_layer: Customer-reported intent in the existing guide envelope; question-map T01. Not external evidence.
guide.fields.intent.goalDetail.readiness_gate: Blocks only the specific task that cannot be scoped; does not block useful general education or labeled browsing. External holds remain independent.

guide.fields.knowledge.general.decision_affected: Explanation depth for the person interacting; not which coverage is suitable or which consequential facts are required.
guide.fields.knowledge.general.trigger: Explanation depth would help the current task and no explicit current preference/self-report is known. Skip a separate ask when the person has already said it or can proceed with useful brief help.
guide.fields.knowledge.general.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit inline choice or clear self-report by the learner/helper. Confirm a material ambiguous interpretation; do not quiz or infer mastery. A helper's familiarity is not evidence about the beneficiary.
guide.fields.knowledge.general.unknown_conflict_handling: Unknown/declined/unanswered remains explicit and never loops or becomes an inferred knowledge label. Let the user correct it or ask for more/less explanation; update presentation only. Conflicting old/new preferences need clarification only if consequential to the current help.
guide.fields.knowledge.general.source_data_layer: User-reported preference in the existing guide envelope; T02. No external Medicare-data layer establishes familiarity. The schema's empty state is metadata, not a report.
guide.fields.knowledge.general.readiness_gate: No availability, timing, drug/provider, cost, Medigap or recommendation gate. Optional familiarity never blocks these conclusions; required factual and external gates remain unchanged.

guide.fields.comparison.scope.zip.decision_affected: Geographic scope of the requested availability/local coverage check for the established beneficiary and relevant period.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.zip.requirement: Conditional: needed when the requested check requires ZIP and an adequate confirmed location is not already known. Not required for general education.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.zip.trigger: A requested geographically scoped check has missing, stale or conflicting home location. Reuse an explicit prior report for the same person/period; ask about the beneficiary, not an unconfirmed helper location.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.zip.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit user-reported home ZIP from typed entry or a previously confirmed relevant report. Formatting validation is not residency verification. Do not silently use device/IP location or a historical address as the current home.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.zip.unknown_conflict_handling: Accept unknown/deferred without inventing a ZIP or borrowing the helper's address. If other reported location facts may suffice, assess them against the exact check's rules; otherwise withhold only affected geographic conclusions. Ask the relevant RC02 clarification when move/seasonal reports conflict. Preserve previous reports and invalidate affected location-dependent results.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.zip.source_data_layer: Customer-reported profile fact. A dated/source-scoped ZIP reference can help resolve geography; exact MA availability uses L02 evidence, and a Florida standalone PDP reference uses L04 regional scope as applicable. Those data layers do not verify residency or personal eligibility.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.zip.readiness_gate: Blocks the affected location-specific check only when required geography remains unresolved. No general-learning block; no ZIP answer alone releases personal recommendations, source acceptance or pricing.

guide.fields.comparison.scope.county.decision_affected: Exact county/state scope when required by the source and requested check; disambiguates a ZIP spanning more than one county.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.county.requirement: Conditional on a county-specific capability/source. No redundant customer question when an adequate known county or unique sourced lookup already supplies it.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.county.trigger: County is required but missing, ambiguous, stale or contradicted by another report; for a unique exact lookup, derive rather than ask again.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.county.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit beneficiary-home county/state report, or a unique ZIP-to-county relationship from an identified dated reference, with origin distinguished. An ambiguous ZIP needs the person's county choice or explicit unknown; never pick the largest/most likely county.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.county.unknown_conflict_handling: Unknown keeps county-specific conclusions unresolved. A lookup failure is a source gap rather than evidence the ZIP is invalid; permit a reported county where supported. Do not silently substitute a nearby county. Reconcile moving/seasonal conflict through the existing RC02 branch.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.county.source_data_layer: User-reported geography or derived ZIP reference in the existing profile. L02 county/year service-area evidence remains separate; statewide L04 published data does not by itself establish individual plan eligibility.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.county.readiness_gate: County-specific availability/network/comparison scope only. State-level reference information can remain within its stated source scope; exact personal claims and independent external gates remain held.

guide.fields.comparison.scope.locationEv.decision_affected: Whether the geographic scope is traceable, reported or derived, and which results need review after location/source changes.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.locationEv.requirement: Conditional provenance requirement whenever a location-derived result is used; system/source bookkeeping, not another customer question.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.locationEv.trigger: Location is reported, derived, corrected or refreshed for the requested check.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.locationEv.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Existing report confirmation/provenance or the actual lookup's source, scope/period and relationship. Never mark a ZIP lookup as verified residency or fabricate a source receipt. Preserve distinction between direct report and derivation.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.locationEv.unknown_conflict_handling: Missing/failed/conflicting source evidence stays explicit. Do not create another personal ask to fill absent reference evidence. Withhold unsupported derived claims, preserve the person's report, and reassess only affected results when corrected.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.locationEv.source_data_layer: Existing guide envelope provenance plus exact ZIP-reference evidence. Availability/benefit-source acceptance is separate from location provenance; this field adds no new data layer or personal fact.
guide.fields.comparison.scope.locationEv.readiness_gate: Traceability guard for the affected geographic derivation/result. Does not establish residence verification, enrollment eligibility, external source acceptance or recommendation readiness.

guide.fields.coverage.requestedStart.decision_affected: Whether the requested task concerns a desired future start, reported existing Medicare or unresolved timing, and which timing details to check next.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStart.requirement: Conditional: required only when this distinction changes the requested task; not a universal learning/browsing requirement.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStart.trigger: Relevant requested timing is missing, changed or ambiguous. Skip the ask when a sufficiently specific confirmed request already supplies it.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStart.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit choice (`month`, `already`, `unknown`) or a clear relevant report recorded with existing confirmation/provenance. Confirm consequential ambiguity rather than inferring enrollment from age, coverage labels or the calendar.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStart.unknown_conflict_handling: Not sure/unanswered/deferred remains unresolved. “Already” does not supply a benefit year, parts or effective dates. Distinguish current status from requested change timing before treating them as conflicting; clarify consequential contradictions without overwriting known reports or looping on unknown.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStart.source_data_layer: Customer-reported request/status in the existing profile; T04 or a confirmed already-known fact. It determines which RC03–RC08 details may matter. It is not official enrollment evidence or an accepted timing-policy rule.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStart.readiness_gate: Blocks only conclusions needing the unresolved requested-start context. General explanations can continue. It never establishes eligibility, a valid enrollment window, an approved effective date or recommendation readiness; official evidence/review remain separate.

guide.fields.coverage.requestedStartMont.decision_affected: Desired month/year for a new start or change, applicable source/benefit year and which exact timing checks are needed.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStartMont.requirement: Conditional: required when the requested conclusion depends on a desired month/year. A separately confirmed benefit year can scope a year-only check without inventing a requested month, subject to that capability's reviewed rules.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStartMont.trigger: A start-dependent requested check has a missing/ambiguous desired month or year; a relevant correction changes the target period.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStartMont.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit user-selected Month and Year or a confirmed report normalized to `YYYY-MM`, with person/task/provenance retained. Confirm consequential interpretations of imprecise or relative dates; no silent current-year, January or day-one assumption.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStartMont.unknown_conflict_handling: Partial or unknown dates stay partial/unresolved in the report; no completed date is fabricated. Previously saved ambiguous wording remains available for correction, not silently parsed. Keep desired timing separate from actual enrollment dates. Reassess affected year/timing results on correction.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStartMont.source_data_layer: Customer-reported desired timing, not published cost/eligibility evidence. Match the explicit target year to exact L01 cost-reference, L02 MA availability, L03 MA benefits or L04 PDP source-year scope only where those sources are used. Actual eligibility/timing conclusions need separate official enrollment evidence and reviewed policy through the existing readiness branches.
guide.fields.coverage.requestedStartMont.readiness_gate: Blocks a requested date-dependent conclusion when the desired period is unresolved, or a year-specific personal check when no other valid confirmed year exists. A requested date does not prove legal ability to start then. Unsupported source years, personal applicability and independent release holds remain explicit.

guide.fields.coverage.current.decision_affected: Reported current-coverage baseline for comparing keep/change paths; which employment, drug-coverage, military, assistance, Medigap or transition checks are consequential. Category selection alone does not settle those checks or identify the exact policies.
guide.fields.coverage.current.requirement: Conditional: mandatory for a personal keep/change, coordination or timing conclusion that depends on current coverage. Not required for general Medicare learning or a published availability check that does not depend on current coverage.
guide.fields.coverage.current.trigger: Requested task needs the current coverage baseline, but categories for the same beneficiary/current period are missing, stale, ambiguous or conflicting. Reuse clear confirmed categories already supplied; ask only for missing consequential distinctions.
guide.fields.coverage.current.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit multi-select report or sufficiently specific confirmed user statement, linked to T05 or the original known-fact report with beneficiary, period, provenance and confirmation retained. One reply can supply several categories. Category-level reports can support preparation; verified enrollment, benefits or continuity claims require the relevant official/program/carrier evidence separately. Do not request government ID numbers to establish a category.
guide.fields.coverage.current.unknown_conflict_handling: Silence is unanswered, never None. Explicit None and Not sure are different and are exclusive global choices in the existing control. Preserve known categories when only a later detail is unknown; do not replace the entire baseline with unknown. Do not auto-correct apparently incompatible same-person/same-period Original/Advantage reports; clarify through RC07/RC28, including whether they refer to different periods. Unsupported coverage types remain explicit gaps rather than forced categories. Allow correction, preserve prior reports, and invalidate only affected dependent conclusions.
guide.fields.coverage.current.source_data_layer: User-reported customer-profile field; existing T05 map/contract or a specific already-known fact. When used, exact published evidence may come from L01 federal costs, L02/L03 MA availability/benefits, L04 PDP, L10 Medigap products/rates, L11 buying rights, L12 assistance, L13 timing/coordination and L14 other paths. Exact drug/provider claims also need L05–L08 evidence. These layer assignments identify dependencies, not accepted personal conclusions; current coverage is not inferred from a catalog match.
guide.fields.coverage.current.readiness_gate: Missing consequential current-coverage context blocks the affected personal keep/change, coordination, timing, rights or cost-baseline conclusion. A reported category satisfies only that report-level item, not every dependent fact. Exact A/B status/dates, program/benefit details, policy identities, accepted rules and external coverage evidence remain separate where relevant. General explanations and independently supported availability information can continue; neither unknown nor a complete category list releases personal recommendations.

guide.fields.needs.providersStatus.decision_affected: Whether the requested personal comparison includes named-provider checks and which further details are relevant. An explicit none-to-check report defines requested scope, not absence of providers or need for care.
guide.fields.needs.providersStatus.requirement: Conditional: required when a requested personal fit/comparison conclusion depends on named-provider scope. Not required for general learning or source-scoped availability alone.
guide.fields.needs.providersStatus.trigger: Relevant scope is missing, changed, unclear or contradicted by another report. Reuse explicit known scope instead of asking a separate status question.
guide.fields.needs.providersStatus.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit free-text report naming providers, stating none requested, deferring or saying unknown, linked to the same beneficiary/task. Confirm a consequential ambiguous interpretation in the echo. Named providers can establish list scope without a preceding Add selection; do not infer list completeness or an absolute exclusion constraint.
guide.fields.needs.providersStatus.unknown_conflict_handling: Unanswered, unknown and deferred remain distinct from none. Preserve known names and item-level uncertainty. A failed catalog match never means the user has no provider. Clarify conflicts about the requested scope without silently deleting prior names; corrections invalidate affected checks only.
guide.fields.needs.providersStatus.source_data_layer: User-reported profile fact from T06 or a specific already-known report, with person/period/confirmation/provenance. The L08 inventory supplies candidate identities, not user preferences. Later access verification needs exact plan/year and accepted provider evidence.
guide.fields.needs.providersStatus.readiness_gate: Unknown/deferred scope blocks a claim that all relevant named-provider needs have been assessed. An explicit none-to-check report closes that requested list only; it does not guarantee access or release recommendations. Candidate matches or autocomplete selections without required explicit confirmation do not establish resolved identity.

guide.fields.needs.providers.decision_affected: Which doctor/hospital and office each typed reference means, and which confirmed identities require access investigation for the requested comparison. Supports every reported item.
guide.fields.needs.providers.requirement: Conditional: required when named-provider checks are requested. New candidate identity bindings need explicit echo confirmation before use as confirmed identities; no names are required for explicit none.
guide.fields.needs.providers.trigger: A new/changed name needs matching, several candidates fit, or consequential identifying detail remains missing. Reuse previously confirmed current identity/office bindings rather than requesting a repeat confirmation without a relevant change.
guide.fields.needs.providers.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Preserve the original free-text names/list. Retrieve evidence-backed candidates from the available inventory, show full identity/practice/location, and obtain the user's explicit confirmation of the intended doctor/office. The same reply/selection can supply existing RC21 entity/practice/city facts. No candidate is silently preselected; confirmation of intended identity remains separate from external record accuracy or plan access verification.
guide.fields.needs.providers.unknown_conflict_handling: Keep candidate, user-confirmed and unresolved item states distinct. Retain unmatched/uncertain names; offer correction, another match or not-listed/unsure. No match is not proof of provider absence or noncoverage. Ask only for missing distinguishing detail. An unavailable source stays an external hold; do not repeat the entire names/location question or erase other confirmed items.
guide.fields.needs.providers.source_data_layer: Customer-reported T06 list plus exact candidate-source record and the user's identity/office confirmation; RC21 entity/practice/city are the existing downstream bindings. L08 Doctors and hospitals is the candidate identity/access layer, with recorded scope/freshness, exact provider/office and relevant plan/product/year for later access checks. L02/L03 provide relevant MA identity/benefit context. Catalog completeness and a working trusted matching adapter are not established here.
guide.fields.needs.providers.readiness_gate: Intended identity remains unresolved until a new candidate is explicitly confirmed or a sufficiently specific existing confirmed binding is reused. Confirmed identity still requires accepted path/plan/year-specific access evidence before a provider-fit claim. An unresolved item blocks its result and an all-providers conclusion, while separately supported results can remain visible. Identity confirmation alone establishes neither coverage, appointments, costs nor recommendation readiness.

guide.fields.needs.medicinesStatus.decision_affected: Whether the requested personal review has reported current prescriptions to check, an explicit report of none, or unresolved/deferred drug scope. It does not establish whether drug insurance is needed or creditable.
guide.fields.needs.medicinesStatus.requirement: Conditional: required when the requested personal coverage/cost conclusion depends on prescription scope. Not required for general learning or independent published availability.
guide.fields.needs.medicinesStatus.trigger: Relevant current drug scope is missing, unclear, changed or conflicting for the same beneficiary/period. Reuse an explicit existing report instead of requiring a separate yes/no turn.
guide.fields.needs.medicinesStatus.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit free-text report/list or current supported selection indicating prescriptions, none, unknown or defer. Preserve beneficiary, period and confirmation/provenance. If a consequential interpretation is unclear, confirm it in the echo; do not infer a complete list from one named drug.
guide.fields.needs.medicinesStatus.unknown_conflict_handling: Unanswered/unknown/deferred never becomes none. Preserve known items if other medicines or details remain unknown. Clarify a consequential conflict between a prior list and a new none report; do not silently erase names. No catalog match is not evidence of no prescriptions.
guide.fields.needs.medicinesStatus.source_data_layer: Customer-reported T07 profile fact or a specific already-known current report. Neither L05 formulary records nor L06 prices establish what this person takes. RC12 drug-coverage notice/history is a separate reported fact, not inferred from prescription use.
guide.fields.needs.medicinesStatus.readiness_gate: Unresolved relevant scope blocks claiming the person's drug needs have been fully evaluated. Explicit none closes the current reported prescription list only; it does not establish insurance sufficiency, enrollment timing, future medicine coverage or recommendation readiness. General work and unaffected supported checks can continue.

guide.fields.needs.medications.decision_affected: Which reported medicines need exact identity resolution, coverage/restriction investigation and, when requested, price evaluation. Includes every requested item rather than only the first name.
guide.fields.needs.medications.requirement: Conditional: required when the person reports prescriptions and requests a drug-related personal conclusion. No list is required for an explicit none report; deferred names remain unresolved.
guide.fields.needs.medications.trigger: A relevant requested medicine is unnamed, ambiguous, newly added, changed or removed. Reuse the current confirmed list and ask only about affected items.
guide.fields.needs.medications.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit reported names/list with original wording; user confirmation of consequential identity interpretations or evidence-backed candidate matches. A prior confirmed fact can supply a name. A carrier/formulary name match alone cannot establish which product the person takes. Medication use does not imply a diagnosis or SNP qualification.
guide.fields.needs.medications.unknown_conflict_handling: Keep each unresolved or unmatched item visible; do not pick a likely drug, drop nonmatched products or turn missing source evidence into a noncoverage finding. Retain supported items while clarifying one ambiguous name. Corrections invalidate affected drug results, not the entire profile.
guide.fields.needs.medications.source_data_layer: Customer-reported T07 list plus a trusted, source/version-linked drug-identity reference where available; existing RC22 item fields hold exact reported name/strength/form details. L05 Drug coverage lists provides exact plan/year formulary/restriction evidence; L06 prices are separate. Identity-source completeness and a matching adapter are not established by this review.
guide.fields.needs.medications.readiness_gate: Missing exact identity blocks that medicine's coverage/price conclusion and any claim that all requested medicines were checked. A clear name alone is not sufficient if strength/form remains ambiguous. Confirmed product identity still needs accepted plan/year formulary/restriction evidence; a reported list never releases recommendations.

guide.fields.needs.medicationDetails.decision_affected: Exact reported strength/form and other relevant per-medicine details for identity/coverage; fill quantity/days supply and consequential administration context for a requested cost/coverage check. This field can retain supplied detail without making every detail mandatory up front.
guide.fields.needs.medicationDetails.requirement: Conditional by capability: exact consequential identity details are required for a concrete drug coverage check; fill quantities/days supply only for the requested pricing scenario. Optional brand/generic preference does not become a universal gate. No unnecessary diagnosis or full clinical history is required.
guide.fields.needs.medicationDetails.trigger: A named drug cannot be uniquely identified for the requested check, a pricing request lacks required fill detail, or a source-supported administration/coverage issue makes a missing detail consequential. Reuse details already given and bound to the correct item.
guide.fields.needs.medicationDetails.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit per-medicine reported strength and form; quantity and days supply when relevant; current confirmed prior facts. Echo consequential interpretations and correct item bindings. Existing RC22/RC23/RC24 fields carry relevant structured details; do not demand a duplicate response merely because T07 stores a text summary.
guide.fields.needs.medicationDetails.unknown_conflict_handling: Preserve partial details and unknowns per item. Never invent strength, form, brand/generic product, fill quantity or days supply. A dosing frequency alone does not supply an actual fill quantity or days supply. Distinguish optional brand/generic preference from unresolved actual drug identity; do not substitute a different medicine or infer a clinical instruction. Clarify conflicts before dependent results.
guide.fields.needs.medicationDetails.source_data_layer: Customer-reported T07 detail, with item-specific RC22 identity, RC23 fill and RC24 consequential setting/problem reports. L05 coverage/restrictions and L06 pricing use the exact relevant product/scenario; source records and reviewed rules remain separate from what the person reports.
guide.fields.needs.medicationDetails.readiness_gate: Unknown consequential strength/form blocks that drug's exact coverage and pricing conclusions. Missing required fill detail blocks the requested price calculation, not an otherwise supportable formulation-level coverage check. Unknown optional brand preference does not erase known identity. Clinic/pharmacy ambiguity holds only the conclusions needing that distinction; external evidence/acceptance remains independent.

guide.fields.needs.pharmacies.decision_affected: Which pharmacy/location or mail-order channel should be used for a requested pharmacy-network or fill-price comparison. A preferred pharmacy is a reported preference, not evidence it is in-network or has the lowest price.
guide.fields.needs.pharmacies.requirement: Conditional: exact pharmacy/location and relevant channel are required for a pharmacy-specific network/price conclusion. Optional/not collected when the requested drug check does not depend on pharmacy.
guide.fields.needs.pharmacies.trigger: The requested pricing/network scenario needs a store/channel that is missing, ambiguous or changed. Reuse an already confirmed relevant pharmacy rather than asking for every medicine again.
guide.fields.needs.pharmacies.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit exact pharmacy/branch/location or mail-order report, linked to the relevant fills; confirm a consequential interpretation or ambiguous branch match. A clear shared pharmacy can supply several RC23 items. If the person has no preference, record that rather than inventing a usual store; any proposed comparison scenario needs explicit agreement and a clear label.
guide.fields.needs.pharmacies.unknown_conflict_handling: Keep unknown/deferred/no preference distinct. A chain name does not silently identify a branch; do not select the nearest store or assume retail/mail order. Missing directory/source evidence is an external gap, not pharmacy absence or a free/zero price. Preserve other known fill facts and ask only for the missing consequential detail.
guide.fields.needs.pharmacies.source_data_layer: Customer-reported T07 pharmacy text plus existing RC23 per-fill pharmacy/channel reports. L07 Pharmacy networks supplies exact identity/network evidence; L06 Personal drug price estimates requires the exact accepted pharmacy/product/fill/plan/year scenario. Directory identity, network participation and price are distinct evidence claims.
guide.fields.needs.pharmacies.readiness_gate: Missing exact relevant pharmacy/channel blocks that pharmacy-specific price/network conclusion, not unrelated general education or a pharmacy-independent coverage finding. A chain/name report alone is not enough for exact store pricing. Complete reports cannot replace the pharmacy identity/network/pricing adapters or source/release acceptance.

guide.fields.needs.travel.decision_affected: Which home/away-care locations, provider access and plan/policy terms matter when comparing coverage paths or investigating personal travel fit. Distinguishes intended routine care from emergency-only concerns; it does not choose a coverage route.
guide.fields.needs.travel.requirement: Conditional: required when the requested personal path/provider/travel conclusion depends on the geography of intended care. Not required for general learning or source-scoped availability alone. Location/duration detail is collected only when a requested exact check needs it.
guide.fields.needs.travel.trigger: Relevant routine-care scope is unassessed, changed, unclear or contradicted by another report. Ask once when consequential; skip when explicit current care-location needs are already known. Open only missing relevant RC20 detail afterward.
guide.fields.needs.travel.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit inline selection or clear confirmed free-text report for the same beneficiary/task/period, including sufficiently specific already-known care needs. Confirm whether a vague travel/seasonal statement actually implies routine care away; do not infer that from a trip or a provider's mailing address alone. Record source and confirmation/provenance.
guide.fields.needs.travel.unknown_conflict_handling: Unknown/deferred never becomes Local only. Preserve known locations when another remains uncertain. Clarify routine versus emergency-only intent and apparent home/seasonal conflicts; a seasonal stay does not silently rewrite permanent residence. Same-state away care is an explicit current-option representation gap, not a forced Local/Another-state choice. Corrections invalidate affected travel/provider results only; do not loop on an unchanged unknown.
guide.fields.needs.travel.source_data_layer: Customer-reported T08 fact or a specific already-known report; RC20 supplies consequential location/context. External evidence must match the actual path, year, destination/provider and service: L03 exact MA benefit/EOC terms, L08 provider/access evidence, relevant L10 Medigap policy terms and reviewed official Original Medicare coverage/access rules where applicable. L02 home/service-area scope remains separate. The accepted L01 published cost reference is not travel-coverage authority, and no data-layer label by itself establishes accepted personal travel fit.
guide.fields.needs.travel.readiness_gate: Missing consequential geography/context blocks the affected away-care/provider-fit conclusion and a complete personal comparison depending on it. It does not block unrelated supported work. Local only closes the reported away-routine-care branch but proves no local access. Unknown is not readiness; a broad travel answer, plan label or an emergency benefit is insufficient evidence of routine access. Accepted exact provider/benefit/policy evidence remains a separate gate; no automatic Original-versus-Advantage preference or recommendation release follows.

guide.fields.needs.costPreference.decision_affected: Which monthly-payment versus care-cost tradeoffs to emphasize in the requested explanation and later accepted comparison. Does not itself select/filter/rank a coverage path, prove affordability or establish lowest total cost.
guide.fields.needs.costPreference.requirement: Optional preference. Never a universal eligibility, coverage, cost-input or recommendation-readiness requirement.
guide.fields.needs.costPreference.trigger: The requested task would benefit from this distinction and an explicit usable current preference is not already known. Skip the ask when a prior confirmed report already states it or when a useful balanced explanation suffices.
guide.fields.needs.costPreference.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit inline choice or a clear confirmed current report, tied to beneficiary/task and provenance. A literal matching T10 preference can supply it; a broad statement that cost matters is not enough to infer which cost dimension. Confirm consequential interpretations of nuanced free text rather than assigning a presumed risk/financial profile.
guide.fields.needs.costPreference.unknown_conflict_handling: Explicit No preference yet differs from unanswered, unknown, deferred or declined. Do not default to low monthly payments or assume unlimited budget. Preserve mixed/conditional preferences; if the current single-choice value cannot represent them, keep classification unresolved rather than forcing a false choice. Clarify a conflict only if needed for the requested task; preserve old reports and permit revision.
guide.fields.needs.costPreference.source_data_layer: User-reported customer-profile preference from T09 or a specific already-known confirmed report. No external dataset establishes what the user prefers. Any actual cost tradeoff needs separate exact-scope evidence from relevant L01 federal costs, L03 MA benefits, L04 PDP facts, L06 drug pricing, L10 Medigap rates and L12 assistance, with accepted applicability/assumptions where required. T09 does not extend the scoped L01 reference acceptance into personal calculations.
guide.fields.needs.costPreference.readiness_gate: No factual readiness gate. Unknown/no preference does not block independently supported checks or balanced explanations and does not satisfy missing required facts elsewhere. A preference-specific conclusion cannot pretend to honor an unknown preference. An answered preference supplies neither personal totals, affordability, eligibility nor independent recommendation/cost-model/source acceptance.

guide.fields.needs.priorities.decision_affected: Which tradeoffs to emphasize and which user-stated needs deserve further relevant investigation in an accepted comparison/explanation. Does not itself verify those needs are satisfied or authorize ranking, exclusions or a coverage-path choice.
guide.fields.needs.priorities.requirement: Optional preferences. Not a universal factual eligibility, coverage, cost-input or recommendation-readiness requirement.
guide.fields.needs.priorities.trigger: A genuine unresolved tradeoff or interpretation of an explicit priority affects the requested conclusion. Reuse earlier explicit priorities; no routine closing/top-three question and no question solely to fill an empty optional field.
guide.fields.needs.priorities.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit selections or a clear confirmed statement tied to the beneficiary/task, with source/confirmation/provenance. A matching T09 predictable-cost preference can supply that priority; a stated wish to keep a named provider can supply a doctor priority. Merely listing a medicine/provider or mentioning travel is not an automatic priority, hard constraint or ranked preference.
guide.fields.needs.priorities.unknown_conflict_handling: Unanswered, Not sure, deferred and no stated priority are distinct from explicit selected priorities. Never preselect, infer numeric weights, rank by click order or truncate additional volunteered meaning. Multiple priorities can coexist; clarify a genuine tradeoff/conflict only when it affects the requested conclusion. Preserve known priorities while any extra detail remains unresolved; permit revision and reassess affected explanations.
guide.fields.needs.priorities.source_data_layer: Customer-reported T10 preference or a specific already-known report; T09 can contribute only an exact semantic match. No external data or commercial relationship establishes the person's priorities. Claims about satisfying them need exact relevant evidence: L08 providers, L05–L07 medicines/pricing/pharmacies, applicable L01/L03/L04/L06/L10/L12 cost evidence and path-specific travel/policy sources. The preference field does not accept or verify those external claims.
guide.fields.needs.priorities.readiness_gate: No universal factual gate. Unknown priorities do not block balanced, independently supported work and cannot satisfy required facts elsewhere. A priority-specific or declared-constraint-satisfying conclusion must remain unresolved when its meaning or required evidence is missing. Selecting Doctors, Prescriptions or Travel does not fill T06/T07/T08 identities/locations or remove external holds; recommendations and personal cost claims remain independently gated.

guide.fields.needs.priorityOther.decision_affected: The meaning and boundaries of an explicitly stated custom priority that the predefined categories do not capture, and which additional supported checks it may require.
guide.fields.needs.priorityOther.requirement: Optional detail; clarification is conditional only when understanding this stated custom priority is necessary to the requested conclusion. It is not a universal intake/readiness requirement.
guide.fields.needs.priorityOther.trigger: Something else or a relevant volunteered custom preference is present but unclear enough to affect the requested task. Skip the follow-up when a specific already-confirmed report supplies its meaning; do not ask for text after an adequate predefined selection.
guide.fields.needs.priorityOther.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit relevant user text or a specific already-known confirmed report; preserve intended meaning and beneficiary context. Echo consequential interpretations rather than inventing a priority, clinical fact, benefit, budget or unsupported service. Collect only enough detail to understand the request.
guide.fields.needs.priorityOther.unknown_conflict_handling: Blank/unknown/deferred stays an unspecified custom priority. Keep separately known predefined priorities. Clarify a conflict only when consequential; do not overwrite or shoehorn the request into a near-enough category. If unsupported by the schema/data/service, retain the limitation rather than promise satisfaction or silently omit it.
guide.fields.needs.priorityOther.source_data_layer: User-reported T10 custom preference, with provenance/confirmation. Any resulting factual check requires its own identified source/data layer, exact scope and release acceptance; the text itself is not external evidence. If no supported evidence layer or fact binding exists, record that as a gap linked to T10/the original report rather than inventing a source.
guide.fields.needs.priorityOther.readiness_gate: Blocks only an unsupported claim to understand/honor that custom priority when its meaning/evidence remains unresolved. General explanations and unaffected factual checks continue. Blank Other text cannot become a required-facts success, blanket recommendation hold, invented benefit or approval of unsupported functionality.

readiness.facts.RC28.value.choice.decision_affected: Correct or resolve the exact reported fact/interpretation needed by a dependent result while preserving beneficiary, time, item, meaning and revision; no standalone coverage interview.
readiness.facts.RC28.value.choice.requirement: Conditional internal integrity/correction check across the conversation. A consumer clarification is necessary only when the actual consequential correction/meaning remains unresolved; no universal closing confirmation, repeated question or required screen.
readiness.facts.RC28.value.choice.trigger: First inspect original report, person/period/scope, prior confirmations and source/result binding. If two consequential reports genuinely disagree about the same fact or a consequential new interpretation remains unconfirmed, ask a named, contextual clarification. Different people, actual versus desired dates, past/future periods, or A/B enrollment versus Advantage benefit delivery are not automatically conflicts. A clear explicit correction already supplies the answer: update the actual reported fact and acknowledge without asking again. A wrong/stale plan/year/source or generated-result error is a system/evidence issue to investigate, not a reason to make the person repeat known facts. Use relevant unselected options/date/text plus another/unknown/defer only when needed.
readiness.facts.RC28.value.choice.acceptable_evidence_or_confirmation: Explicit correction with unambiguous target/replacement or response confirming the named fact/interpretation, retaining original and replacement report, beneficiary/item/period, actor/source/confirmation/revision and relevant date precision. Reuse existing consequential confirmation instead of replaying RC28. Update the real T04/T05/provider/drug/budget/other supported field; choice is only correction disposition and cannot store the corrected value by itself. Do not invent target bindings when representation is insufficient; preserve G14. Corrected reports remain verified:false unless independently verified evidence separately supports the actual claim.
readiness.facts.RC28.value.choice.unknown_conflict_handling: Unknown/defer/Neither does not select a preferred fact or mean no coverage. They apply at different times needs actual period binding before time-dependent findings; it is not permission to guess dates. Do not choose most recent/likely/nearest merely because it looks plausible. Distinguish an explicit correction that supersedes an old report from an unresolved new conflict; retain history rather than leave superseded reports as active contradictions. No global reset or unrelated re-asks. User confirmation cannot erase contrary external evidence or turn a disputed source result into verified coverage. Original Medicare/Advantage response choices cannot encode arbitrary dates/names/products or full current coverage; retain original reports and G04/G13/G14 gaps instead of forcing them.
readiness.facts.RC28.value.choice.source_data_layer: Existing customer-profile report/confirmation provenance; original and corrected customer reports plus actual target-field/item/person/period and source/confirmation/revision provenance; exact domain/source evidence for any dependent external claim. Check source version/year/identity and interpretation errors before asking. Medicare.gov health-plan guidance checked October 27 supports distinguishing Part A/B entitlement from the way benefits are received; no automatic Original/Advantage conflict from A/B alone. Correction confirmation is not independent benefit verification, personal eligibility or acceptance of an external source. This describes required evidence, not independent acceptance.
readiness.facts.RC28.value.choice.readiness_gate: Hold only results actually depending on the unresolved fact, or a comprehensive claim including it; unrelated supported work continues. A clear correction updates the target report and marks affected old findings stale/recomputes dependencies with provenance, including newly applicable conditional questions, without treating them as answered. The original empty staleOnChange list cannot preserve an outdated dependent finding. Repeat user confirmation only for a genuinely new consequential interpretation; independent verification remains required by the exact external claim and is never replaced by a corrected report. Neither choice nor complete reported correction releases recommendation, policy/source or personal coverage gates.
